links.outcome: Patient comprehension of key findings and follow-up, AI plain-language vs original radiology reports
links.effect: AI plain language reports had higher comprehension (68.0% vs 58.0%; marginal difference 10.8% [95% CI 7.8%-13.8%]) and follow-up accuracy (64.5% vs 58.4%; 6.8% [4.1%-9.4%]). Larger gains among older and less-educated participants.
links.quote: Compared to original reports, participants shown AI-generated plain language reports had higher accuracy in comprehension (68.0% vs 58.0%; marginal difference 10.8% [95% CI, 7.8%-13.8%]) and follow-up (64.5% vs 58.4%; marginal difference 6.8% [95% CI, 4.1%-9.4%]).

unlisted_practices: AI simplification of radiology reports into plain language for patient portals
Patient preference for original vs AI-simplified reports (60% preferred original)

screen.reason: Empirical vignette study evaluating patient comprehension and anxiety with LLM-simplified radiology reports versus original reports. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
